description: Fully animated, open-source component distribution built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, and Shadcn CLI. Browse a list of components you can install, modify, and use in your projects.
readme: Animate UI Animated drop-in primitives for Radix UI, Base UI and React Aria, built with Motion. Swap the import, keep your shadcn/ui components. Getting started Animate every installed shadcn/ui component in one command: npx @animate-ui/cli@latest animate all Or swap a primitive's import yourself: // Before import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from 'radix-ui'; // After import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from '@animate-ui/react/primitives/radix-ui'; Documentation Visit animate-ui.com to view the documentation. Contributing Visit our contributing guide to learn how to contribute. Code of Conduct This project follows a Code of Conduct to help create a welcoming community. Please read CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md before contributing.
